name: PandaLily
bio: Half girl, half red panda, and full-time caretaker of the Zenith Bamboo grove. PandaLily drifted out of the forest one day, decided streaming was more fun than hibernating, and never really left.
duty: Keeping the bamboo forest calm and green, looking after the spirits (and viewers) who wander through it, and making sure nobody leaves without a snack.
